description: Defines the ReadWriteLock class implementing a read-write lock mechanism with methods for acquiring and releasing read and write locks, using internal state management and synchronization primitives.

classes.name: ReadWriteLock
classes.description: A class providing synchronization for multiple readers or a single writer, managing internal state and lock acquisition/release.

methods.name: ReadWriteLock
methods.description: Constructor initializing the lock state and reader count.

methods.name: ~ReadWriteLock
methods.description: Destructor asserting that no readers remain and the lock is idle.

methods.name: ReadLock
methods.description: Attempts to acquire a read lock within a specified wait time.

methods.name: ReadUnlock
methods.description: Releases a previously acquired read lock.

methods.name: WriteLock
methods.description: Attempts to acquire a write lock within a specified wait time.

methods.name: WriteUnlock
methods.description: Releases a previously acquired write lock.
